subject: Itch and pain split by a single gene switch in spinal neurons
script: From Agewell Brief: Itch and pain split by a single gene switch in spinal neurons. A preprint reveals that Grpr+ spinal neurons contain two subtypes—Tac1+ for mechanical allodynia, Tac1− for itch—and shows genomic enhancers can silence each to reverse symptoms. Grpr+ neurons split into Tac1+ (pain) and Tac1− (itch) subtypes. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
